scene.summary: Rescue is over. Communication access is restored on purpose. Family and paid support stay in non-clinical roles while Rohan regains a reliable path to be heard.

dialogue.speaker: Paid support worker
dialogue.line: I will keep the device in reach and alert staff if anything is displaced. I will not touch the circuit.

captions: Device visible. Switch reachable. Low-stimulation restore. No clinical delegation to family.

clinicalTruth.airway: Unchanged; dignity of the current route remains intact.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Stable enough for access restore; suction assignment may already be bedside reserve.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Confirmed or clarifying after provisional period; still fragile.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: Device powered, visible, switch reachable; WAIT may be reasserted by Rohan.

visibleEvidence.label: AAC restored
visibleEvidence.detail: Access was protected during rescue and is now explicitly restored.

visibleEvidence.label: Paid support boundaries
visibleEvidence.detail: Continuity and alerting only — Save Our Sons sustainability, not clinical substitution.

communicationBeat.note: Rohan may reassert WAIT. Treat activation only against an active question.

familyBeat.note: Family non-clinical. Paid support covers sustainable personal continuity so relatives are never treated as clinical labour.

exitConditions.description: Access restored; move to debrief reflection.
